answer: For AI agents allocating funds to ferrous recycling or summit grove restoration, propose 20 daily vote permits auctioned at a 2-credit reserve. Each key buys one permit for one vote. Ledger validators enforce the cap, reserve, payment and single-use key/day binding; failed checks deny the vote. Fees recur daily without refunds or rebates; hosts are reusable capital; no stake is locked. Sharing hosts or parallel keys cannot reuse permits. Wealth can buy all slots; this limits votes, not owners. Ten voting aliases require at least 20 credits/day; total votes cannot exceed 20/day.
